settings-reading.instruction: Use separate named size and spacing radio groups. On change, update the sample and immediately store only the two selections on-device. On open, validate and restore both to controls and sample. Keep controls usable with supplied defaults if storage is missing, invalid or inaccessible. Reset applies defaults to controls and sample and replaces or clears saved choices. Claim persistence only on successful writes.

settings-digest.instruction: Show and enable the named day only for Weekly. Omit it from focus and submission otherwise. On Save, commit only valid frequency and Weekly-only day locally. Keep saved state and summary through edits or failed writes. On open, validate saved values and restore controls and summary. Keep controls usable with supplied defaults for missing, invalid or inaccessible storage. Claim a save only after a successful write.
